origins.neoorigins.frostborn.name: Frostborn

origins.neoorigins.strider.description: Yiwet n lxelq ameqqran ițeddun ɣef lqaɛa, yesseḥla di ṭṭmeɛ-ines, ma d lqaɛa d waman yesseɣlayen.
power.neoorigins.strider_fire_immunity.d: lǧețțat n tmes, leḥwayeǧ, lqayen n lemma d lmeṣnuɛat.

mkul sennig, m'ara d-tewwi snat n lexṣaṣ, m'ara d-yaweḍ waman neɣ m'ara d-yețwaxleq.

power.neoorigins.strider_night_vision.de: Tzemrem aț-țeẓrem di ṭṭlam s wayes ara yesɛu ṭṭlam. Tbeggneḍ-ed aț-țfeṛḥem aqcic n wawal n yiḍ.
power.neoorigins.strider_natural_armor.d: Ɣuṛ-iyi-d ad ḥadreɣ di dayem, aql-i ṭṭmeɛ n ccwal.
origins.neoorigins.siren.name: Simeren
origins.neoorigins.siren.description: Yiwet n tejmaɛt i d-ilulen di lebḥeṛ yeldi, d leḥṛam i d-yesseḥlayen, yesseḥlayen di lebḥeṛ, yesseḥlayen, yesseɣlayen, yesseɣli-d ɣef lqaɛa.

power.neoorigins.siren_charm.description: Imdanen meṛṛa ur k-d-ițțak ara lexbaṛ m'ur ten-tḥesbem ara d amezwaru.

power.neoorigins.siren_dries_out.name: Rrif dinna

origins.neoorigins.piglin.name: Siglin

power.neoorigins.piglin_nether_buff.name: Aṭas n tlemmatin

power.neoorigins.piglin_night_vision.des: Tzemrem aț-țeẓrem di ṭṭlam. Tbeggiḍ-ed aț-țfehmem ɣef tṭercicin n wawal n yiḍ (imezwura K).

origins.neoorigins.hiveling.name: Ifeṛḥen

power.neoorigins.hiveling_flight.descrip: ?ef wannect-agi, ṭṭmeɛ am imezdaɣ n imezdaɣ n imezdaɣ n Elytra, ițțuẓummen ; ṭṭeggiḍ m'ara ɣliɣ iwakken a d-ɣli.

power.neoorigins.hiveling_size.name: Efram Ciṭer

origins.neoorigins.cinderborn.name: ?eqqṛet

Sɛut tazmert m'ara tesɛi lǧețțat di tlemmast ; m'ara t-id-yefk lqaɛa ad tseddqen times.

power.neoorigins.cinderborn_night_vision: Times iḍaṛṛen țfeǧǧiǧen ula d iẓekwan ṭṭlam. Tbeggneḍ-ed aqcic n wawal n yiḍ (ițțusemman K).

origins.neoorigins.sculkborn.name: Squlqborn

power.neoorigins.sculkborn_daylight_dama: M'ara d-yaweḍ tnac n lexṣaṣ m'ara d-yaweḍ yiṭij.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_vibration_sen: Tețfeǧǧiǧ imdanen i gzedɣen, teẓriḍ tezmert-nsen di lqaɛa.
power.neoorigins.sculkborn_reduced_healt: -2 ulawen (-4 taxaṭer HP). Lǧețța n weɣṛum i d-ițwaxleq d acemma.
